method: Real FightEngine.render via source HTTP. QA moves both fighters across the arena in 15 fixed steps; frame and world matrix are recorded. Reduced motion and stage-animation preferences are checked at the same endpoints.

checks: full background stays fixed in world space
near plane shifts independently and monotonically
observed displacement agrees with declared depth
near image has genuinely transparent and painted regions
reduced motion retains both images at their neutral placement
switching off stage animation retains a stable scene
both players walk using keyboard input, moving the near plane relative to the background
no page exceptions
